Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (during the first turn after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly inferred that the "World Boxing Hall of Fame" was the larger organization associated with the IBF title. The search results provided by the WebSurfer did not mention a "World Boxing Hall of Fame" in relation to the IBF; they only mentioned "The Ring magazine" and "Upset of the Year." The Planner hallucinated this specific name instead of proceeding to the next logical step of searching for the actual association between the IBF and a Hall of Fame, which was only correctly identified in the subsequent turn.
